descripcion: At B2 an opinion needs a clear stance and a concrete reason — I think, because is the backbone. The C1 refinements (a stated reservation before the opinion, a pre-empted counter-argument) aren't the goal here; a well-supported, clearly stated view is.

filas: I think this is a good idea.
For example, people could work from home.

ejemplos.texto: I think this is a good idea, because it gives people more flexibility.
In my opinion, this needs to be looked at more carefully.
For example, people could work from home on certain days.

notas: In my opinion is slightly more formal than I think and fits well in a discussion.
An opinion without a reason feels incomplete at B2 — because should almost always follow.
One concrete example makes a reason far more convincing than an abstract statement.

es.en: «Creo que» corresponds to I think and «en mi opinión» to in my opinion, so the basic structure transfers. In my opinion sounds slightly more formal in English and is often replaced by I think or I'd say in conversation.
es.es: «Creo que» corresponde a «I think» y «en mi opinión» a «in my opinion», por lo que la estructura básica se transfiere. «In my opinion» suena algo más formal en inglés y en conversación suele sustituirse por «I think» o «I'd say».

de.en: «Meiner Meinung nach» corresponds to in my opinion, and «ich finde» usually to I think; I find works mainly for personal impressions (I find it boring). German speakers tend to overuse I find for opinions in general.
de.de: «Meiner Meinung nach» entspricht «in my opinion», und «ich finde» entspricht meistens «I think»; «I find» passt eher bei persönlichen Eindrücken («I find it boring»). Deutschsprachige verwenden «I find» oft zu allgemein für Meinungen.

it.en: «Secondo me» is often calqued as according to me, which English uses only for reported views, not one's own opinion. The natural equivalents are I think and in my opinion.
it.it: «Secondo me» viene spesso calcato come «according to me», che in inglese si usa solo per opinioni riferite, non per la propria. Gli equivalenti naturali sono «I think» e «in my opinion».

fr.en: «Selon moi» is often calqued as according to me, which English uses only for reported views, not one's own opinion. The natural equivalents are I think and in my opinion; «à mon avis» maps well onto the latter.
fr.fr: «Selon moi» est souvent calqué en «according to me», expression qui en anglais sert à rapporter le point de vue d'autrui, pas le sien. Les équivalents naturels sont «I think» et «in my opinion» ; «à mon avis» correspond bien au second.

pt.en: «Acho que» is often calqued as I find that, because «achar» also means to find; this sounds formal and odd for everyday opinions. The natural equivalent is I think.
pt.pt: «Acho que» costuma ser calcado como «I find that», porque «achar» também significa «find»; em opiniões cotidianas isso soa formal e estranho. O equivalente natural é «I think».

errores: Stating an opinion with no reason at all.
Using because as a sentence on its own without connecting it to the opinion.
Combining in my opinion and I think in the same sentence, which is redundant.

redemittel.funcion: opinion and main reason in one move

traducciones.de: Ich finde das vor allem deshalb, weil…
traducciones.fr: Je le pense surtout parce que…

traducciones.de: Da bin ich mir ziemlich sicher.

redemittel.expresion: I'm not sure, but I'd say…

traducciones.de: Ich bin nicht sicher, aber ich würde sagen…
traducciones.fr: Je n'en suis pas sûr, mais je dirais…
traducciones.pt: Não tenho a certeza, mas diria…

redemittel.expresion: That's just my view, of course.

traducciones.de: Das ist natürlich nur meine Sicht.
traducciones.fr: Ce n'est que mon avis, bien sûr.
traducciones.it: È solo la mia opinione, certo.
traducciones.pt: É apenas a minha opinião, claro.

redemittel.funcion: invites the other person's opinion, informal

autochequeo: Have I clearly stated my opinion?
Does a concrete reason follow with because or a similar phrase?
Have I given at least one example?
Does the reason sound concrete rather than abstract?
Have I avoided combining two opinion phrases in the same sentence?
promptCorreccion: Focus only on whether the opinion and the reason are clearly connected. Check whether at least one concrete example is given. Do not rewrite the text.

es: «*Lo que pasa es que*» rendered as *What happens is that* instead of *The thing is*.
de: «*Ich bin der Meinung, dass*» rendered as *I am of the meaning that* instead of *I'm of the opinion that*.
it: «*Il discorso è che*» rendered as *The discourse is that* instead of *The point is*.
fr: «*Le truc, c'est que*» rendered as *The thing, it's that* instead of *The thing is*.
pt: «*O que acontece é que*» rendered as *What happens is that* instead of *The thing is*.
